Generate business rules documentation for the following 19 modules of the NexStep ERP system (IBM i / AS/400 RPG IV).

For each module, write one complete markdown document. Separate each document with the output delimiter described below.

OUTPUT DELIMITER: Before writing each module's document, output this line alone on its own line:
===FILE:docs/<output-filename>===

STANDARD DOCUMENT FORMAT (apply identically to every module):

# Business Logic for [Module Name]

[Introduction paragraph: what process/module this covers, which RPG programs are involved,
and that the document focuses on conditions that BLOCK or PREVENT the operation]

## Prerequisites / Master Data Requirements
## Validation Rules
## Configuration and Authorization Rules
## Financial / Transactional Rules
## Status and Lifecycle Rules
## Special Conditions (Program-Specific)

For each rule within a category, use this exact format:

X.  **[Rule Name]**
    *   **Logic:** [One sentence explaining what the rule does]
    *   **File:** [Database file name] ([English description])
    *   **Field:** [Field name(s) only — no file name, e.g. `FOKODE` not `FOHEPF.FOKODE`]
    *   **Condition:** [Exact condition that triggers blocking, including RPG indicator names like *in41 if known]

## Subprogram Calls Affecting Logic
| Program | Trigger | Logic | Impact |
|---------|---------|-------|--------|
[one row per called subprogram — distinguish Blocking vs. Informational in Impact column]

## Reference Tables
[Status codes, type codes, and other lookup values referenced in the rules above]

---
MODULES TO DOCUMENT:
---

MODULE 1 — Invoice Processing
Output file: docs/invoice-business-rules.md
Programs: FO616R (invoice calculation engine), FO615R (invoice line processing)
Primary tables:
- SOHEPF: Invoice Header (SOFSUM=total, SOFKDA=invoice date, SOFRDA=due date, SOKIDN=KID, SOFORS=deposit deduction)
- SODTPF: Invoice Lines (SDVARE=product, SDANTA=qty, SDSAPR=price, SDMVA=tax code)
- VMVAPF: Tax/VAT Master (VAMVA=tax code, VAPROC=tax %)
- AARRF: Accounting Period (ARSTRT=status, ARPERR=period#)
- RKUNPF: Customer Master (discounts: RERAB1, RERAB2, RERAB3)
- SDEPPFR: Deposit file (deposit amounts)
Focus: Conditions that block invoice creation after orders have been selected.
NOTE: Do NOT include order-level validation (customer existence, order status, order locks,
user authorization) — those belong in the sales order document.

MODULE 2 — Sales Order Management
Output file: docs/sales-order-business-rules.md
Programs: FO100R, FO500R, FO614R, FO730R
Primary tables:
- SOHEPF/FOHEPF: Sales Order Header (FOSTUS=status, FOKUND=customer, FOBINR=invoice ref,
  FOKODE=lock, SOOTYP=order type, SONUMM=order#, SOSELG=salesperson, SOLAGE=warehouse,
  SOBDAT=order date, SOLDAT=delivery date, SOINF1/SOINF2=info hold codes)
- FODTPF/SODTPF: Order Lines (FDVARE/SDVARE=product, FDANTA/SDANTA=qty,
  FDSAPR/SDSAPR=price, SDRAB1/SDRAB2=discounts, SDLTYP=line type)
- RKUNPF: Customer Master (RKKUND=cust#, RKSPER=blocked, RKKRSP=credit stop,
  RKGRNS=credit limit, RKMEPF.RKMEMA=memo balance)
- VOTYPF: Order Types (VASYST=system flag)
- VLTPPF: Delivery Types
- RA07PF: Warehouses, RA09PF: Salespersons, RA17PF: Shipping Methods
Focus: Conditions that block order creation, modification, picking, and fulfillment.

MODULE 3 — Customer and Accounts Receivable
Output file: docs/customer-ar-business-rules.md
Programs: RK100R, RK108R, RK110R, RK400R, RK500R, RK620R,
          RE110R, RE120R, RE600R, RE601R, RE602R, RE603R, RE609R,
          RE613R, RE615R, RE621R, RE623R, RE630R, RE632R, RE633R,
          AR100R, AR700R
Primary tables:
- RKUNPF: Customer Master (RKNAVN=name, RKALFA=alpha key, RKFTNR=org number,
  RKSPRK=block status, RKFAKU=invoice customer, RKGRNS=credit limit,
  RKKRSP=credit block level, RKBETB=payment terms, RKPASS=passive flag, RKEMAL=email)
- RKMEPF: Customer Memo Balance (RKMEMA=memo amount — real-time credit exposure)
- RKTRPF: Customer Postings (field prefix RN — RNFIRM, RNKUND, RNBILK, RNBELØ,
  RNREST, RNSTAT, RNKID, RNFDAT)
- REKUPF: AR Ledger Summary
- REMSPF: GL/AR Posting Registration (field prefix RT)
Field prefix note: RKTRPF uses prefix RN (not RT).
RE01PF/RE02PF/RE03PF are GL reporting tables only — NOT AR transaction tables.
Focus: Conditions that block customer creation/modification, credit approval,
payment processing, and AR posting.

    RA511R, RA512R, RA513R, RA514R, RA515R, RA516R, RA517R, RA518R, RA519R,
    RA520R, RA521R, RA522R, RA523R, RA524R, RA525R, RA526R, RA527R, RA528R,
    RA529R, RA530R, RA531R, RA532R, RA533R, RA534R, RA535R, RA536R, RA537R,
    RA580R, RA582R, RA589R, RA5S5R
Primary tables:
- RAA1PF: Company Status Parameters (RA1FIR=company, RA1BKK=bank code,
  RA1PER=current period, RA1AAR=year, RA1BNR=last document#, RA1MVA=VAT code,
  RA1KTO=default account, RA1AVD=department, RA1SPS=block flag, RA1AKT=active flag)
- RAA2PF: Balance/Marking Codes (RA2FIR, RA2BBK, RA2BMK, RA2AKO, RA2ABK)
- RA01PF: Document/Voucher Codes (RAAKOD=type code, RAATXT, RAAKJØ=direction,
  RAAINK=include flag, RAABNR=document series#, RADEBE=debit account, RAKRED=credit account)
- RA02PF: Payment Methods (RABKOD, RABTXT)
- RA03PF: Payment Terms (RACKOD, RACTXT, RACDAG=net days, RACRAB=discount%)
- RA04PF: Company Information/Parameters (RADFIR=company key, RADK/RADS/RADA series=parameter keys/settings/values)
- RA05PF: VAT/Tax Codes (RAEKOD, RAETXT, RAEPRO=rate%, RAEINV=invoice flag,
  RAEGPR=output GL account, RAEGIN=input GL account)
- RA06PF: Discount Categories (RAFKOD, RAFTXT)
- RA07PF: Department/Branch Register (RAGKOD, RAGTXT, RAGADR, RAGLTY=warehouse type, RAGPRG=price group)
- RA08PF: Sales Districts (RAHKOD, RAHTXT)
- RA09PF: Salesperson Register (RAIKOD, RAITXT, RAIKTO=GL account, RAIBLK=block flag, RAIEMA=email)
- RA10PF: External Locations (RAJKOD, RAJTXT, RAJADR, RAJAVD=department)
- RA11PF: Customer Categories (RAKKOD, RAKTXT, RAKKTO=GL account, RAKSPS=block,
  RAKGRN=credit limit, RAKUGR=user group, RAKKPR=price group)
- RA12PF: Country Codes (RALKOD, RALTXT, RALSPR=language, RALPFX=phone prefix)
- RA13PF: GL Distribution Keys (RAMKOD, RAMTXT, RAMP01-13=allocation percentages — must total 100%)
- RA14PF: Supplier Categories (RANKOD, RANTXT, RANKTO=GL account, RANSPS=block)
- RA15PF: Quantity/Unit Conversion Codes (RAOKOD, RAOTXT, RAOFAK=factor)
- RA16PF: Currency Codes (RAPKOD, RAPMNA=name, RAPMFO=buy rate, RAPMKU=sell rate,
  RAPSPS=block flag, RAPKDA=rate date)
- RA17PF: Shipping Methods (RAQKOD, RAQTXT, RAQDIR=direction, RAQKJO=vehicle type)
- RA18PF: Delivery Terms/INCOTERMS (RARKOD, RARTX1/2/3)
- RA19PF: Account Classes (RASKOD, RASTXT, RASSDK=default account, RASBFA=balance/P&L flag)
- RA20PF: Account Groups (RATKOD, RATTXT, RATSDK=default account, RATBFA=balance/P&L flag)
- RA25PF: Delivery Routes (RAYRUT, RAYTXT)
- RA26PF: Product Handlers/Buyers (RAZSAK, RAZTXT, RAZEMA=email)
- RA30PF: Price Groups (REDKOD, REDTXT)
Focus: Conditions that block creation or modification of setup codes and master registers
used as foreign keys across all other ERP modules. Key areas:
- Duplicate code prevention (unique code+company key)
- In-use deletion blocking when referenced by active records
- RA13PF allocation percentages must total 100%
- Currency block flag (RA16PF.RAPSPS) and rate date validity
- VAT code mandatory fields (rate, GL accounts) before the code can be used
- Company parameter completeness (RA04PF/RAA1PF) required for module activation
- Salesperson block flag (RA09PF.RAIBLK) preventing assignment to new orders
- Customer/supplier category block flags cascading to customer/supplier records
NOTE: RA000R and RA100R are central dispatchers routing by code-type parameter.
RA5xx programs are read-only inquiry screens.

  Specialized / Card / Export:
    RF810R, RF811R, RF812R, RF812R_GML, RF813R, RF814R,
    RF820R, RF820R_SBM, RF825R, RF826R, RF827R, RF829R,
    RF850R, RF856R, RF926R,
    RF950R, RF951R, RF952R, RF953R, RF960R,
    RFA15R, RFB15R, RFI15R, RFP14R, RFP15R, RFP16R, RFP55R, RFSYSR
Primary tables:
- RTRAPF: Journal Transaction Lines (RTFIRM, RTBUNT=batch#, RTLINJ=line#,
  RTSTAT=status, RTBDAT=voucher date, RTBELØ=amount, RTRAAR=year, RTRPER=period,
  RTBILN=document#, RTBILK=voucher type, RTDKTO=debit account, RTDAVD=debit dept,
  RTDSPS=debit sub-account, RTDMVA=debit VAT code, RTCKTO=credit account,
  RTCAVD=credit dept, RTCSPS=credit sub-account, RTCMVA=credit VAT code,
  RTPROS=project, RTVALK=currency, RTVALB=foreign amount, RTMNGD=quantity,
  RTKIDI/RTKIDR=KID payment IDs, RTLFAK=supplier invoice#, RTTEXT=description,
  RTBETB=payment terms, RTRESN/RTRESS/RTRESA/RTRESM=AR/AP sub-ledger refs,
  RTNIVO=level, RTMEMB=member)
- RBUNPF: Batch/Bundle Header (RSFIRM, RSBUNT=batch#, RSSTAT=status,
  RSRAAR=year, RSRPER=period, RSBSUM=control sum, RSPSUM=posted sum,
  RSPDEB=posted debit, RSPKRE=posted credit, RSPTYP=batch type)
- RFORPF: GL Distribution/Allocation Parameters (RFKODE=alloc code, RFFIRM,
  RFKONT=source account, RFLINJ=line type B/O/P, RFPROS=project,
  RFKTO1/RFKTO2=target accounts, RFAVD1/RFAVD2=target depts)
Focus: Conditions that block journal entry registration, batch posting,
GL distribution execution, and transaction reversal. Key areas:
- Batch control sum mismatch (RBUNPF.RSBSUM vs sum of RTRAPF.RTBELØ)
- Accounting period closed/locked (RAA1PF.RA1PER)
- Account not in chart of accounts (RHOVPF)
- Both debit and credit are sub-ledger accounts — not allowed simultaneously
- Invalid/missing VAT code when account requires VAT
- Duplicate supplier invoice# (RTLFAK) within company/year
- Currency blocked (RA16PF.RAPSPS) for foreign currency entries
- Distribution parameters (RFORPF) creating unbalanced allocations
- KID format validation for Norwegian payment processing
- User/member authorization for batch access (RTMEMB)
NOTE: RF010R is the central journal entry screen. RF102R runs distribution after
line entry. RF5xx are read-only log inquiry. RF8xx/RF9xx handle card/spreadsheet exports.

  RHMVAK=VAT code purchases, RHMVAO=VAT code sales, RHMVAG=VAT group,

  RHPROJ=project required flag, RHBÆRK=cost bearer required flag,
  RHMNGD=quantity required flag, RHKPG1-5=account plan group codes)
- RHTRPF: GL Posted Ledger Entries (RBFIRM, RBKONT, RBSPES, RBAVDE,
  RBRAAR=year, RBRPER=period, RBBDAT=date, RBBILN=document#, RBBILK=doc type,
  RBTEXT, RBNETO=net amount, RBMVAG/RBAMVA/RBPMVA=VAT amounts,
  RBVALK=currency, RBVALB=foreign amount, RBJOUR=journal#,
  RBPROS/RBHPRO/RBUPRO/RBAKTI=project fields, RBAVST=reconciliation status,
  RBTIST=timestamp, RBSPOR=trace ref, RBAVKR=reconciliation crossref)

- RHJOPF: Journal Number Register (RBFIRM, RBJOUR=journal sequence# for audit trail)
- RHWAPF/RHW1PF/RHW2PF: GL Posting Work Files (temporary staging — same layout as RHTRPF)
Focus: Conditions that block account creation/modification, GL posting to
closed periods, balance matrix updates, and deletion of posted transactions. Key areas:
- Account deletion when RHTRPF postings exist for that account
- Balance type change (RHBNØK B/R/I) when RHSAPF has existing balances
- Required dimension flags (RHAVDK/RHPROJ/RHBÆRK/RHMNGD) — posting lines missing
  mandatory department, project, cost bearer, or quantity are blocked
- Duplicate account key (RHFIRM+RHKONT+RHSPES+RHAVDE)
- VAT code on account (RHMVAK/RHMVAO) must exist in RA05PF
- Period balance deletion (RH400R) requires company+year confirmation
- Journal# (RHJOPF.RBJOUR) must be unique per company
NOTE: RH100R is the central chart-of-accounts maintenance program.
RH5xx are inquiry/lookup. RH6xx-RH9xx are report parameter and print programs.
RHWAPF/RHW1PF/RHW2PF are temporary work files — not permanent transaction stores.

MODULE 19 — Supplier / Accounts Payable (RL)
Output file: docs/supplier-ap-business-rules.md
Programs:
  Supplier Master Maintenance:
    RL100R, RL101R, RL108R, RL109R, RL110R, RL112R, RL113R, RL120R,
    RL190R, RL191R
  AP Posting / Payment Processing:
    RL400R, RL401R, RL402R, RL403R,
    RL600R, RL601R,
    RL620R, RL621R, RL622R, RL623R, RL628R, RL629R,

    RL674R, RL675R
  Inquiry:
    RL500R, RL501R, RL502R, RL503R,
    RL510R, RL511R, RL512R, RL513R, RL514R, RL515R, RL516R, RL517R,
    RL580R
  Reports / Export:
    RL750R, RL751R, RL752R, RL789R,
    RL910R, RL920R, RL933R,
    RL970R, RL971R, RL974R, RL975R
Primary tables:
- RLEVPF: Supplier Master (RLFIRM, RLLEVR=supplier#, RLNAVN=name, RLALFA=alpha key,
  RLFTNR=org number, RLEMAL=email, RLBGIR=bank giro, RLLAND=country,
  RLKATG=category, RLRABK=discount category, RLBETB=payment terms, RLBETM=payment method,
  RLISOK=ISO code, RLVALK=currency, RLSPRK=language, RLSPER=block flag,
  RLPASS=passive flag, RLKUNR=customer cross-ref, RLEDIK=EDI code, RLEANL=EAN,
  RLNOBB=NOBB#, RLSLET=deleted flag)
- RLTRPF: AP Postings/Transactions (ROFIRM, ROLEVR=supplier#, RORAAR=year,
  RORPER=period, ROBDAT=date, ROBILN=document#, ROBILK=doc type,
  ROBELØ=amount, ROREST=remainder/open balance, ROVALK=currency, ROVALB=foreign amount,
  ROFDAT=due date, ROJOUR=journal#, ROBETK=payment code, ROREFN=reference,
  ROLFAK=supplier invoice#, ROKIDI=KID, ROTIST=timestamp,
  ROAVST=reconciliation status, ROSPOR=trace ref, ROAVKR=reconciliation crossref)
- RLBAPF: Foreign Bank Information (RVFIRM, RVLEVR, RVHSWA=SWIFT/BIC,
  RVHBA1-4=IBAN address lines, RVHBKO=bank account#, RVHBKU=currency, RVHBKI=bank ID)
- RLTXPF: AP Reconciliation Crossref (same layout as RLTRPF with POTIST/POTISD timestamps)
- RLSOPF: Supplier Search Text Register (RLSFIR, RLSLEV, RLSTEK=search text)
- RLE2PF: Supplier Supplementary Register (RL2FIR, RL2LEV, RL2UOG=foreign org number)
Focus: Conditions that block supplier creation/modification, AP posting, payment
processing, reconciliation, and supplier deletion. Key areas:
- Supplier block flag (RLEVPF.RLSPER) preventing new transactions
- Passive flag (RLEVPF.RLPASS) preventing assignment to new orders
- Supplier deletion blocked when items exist in VVARPF or VVLEPF for that supplier
- Duplicate supplier invoice# (RLTRPF.ROLFAK) within company/supplier/year
- Foreign bank info (RLBAPF) — SWIFT/IBAN required for international payments
- Payment terms (RLBETB) must exist in RA03PF before supplier can be saved
- Currency (RLVALK) must exist and be active in RA16PF
NOTE: RL100R is the central supplier maintenance program.
RL4xx programs handle AP posting and payment file generation.
RL5xx are read-only inquiry screens. RL6xx/RL7xx handle payment runs and reports.

---
GLOBAL RULES FOR ALL DOCUMENTS:
- Focus on what BLOCKS or PREVENTS the operation
- Use DB2 TABLE.COLUMN notation (e.g., RKUNPF.RKKUND)
- Do NOT include SQL queries — use plain English: "What is checked", "Why this is required",
  "What happens when" language with real-world examples
- Write all 19 documents in order, one after another
- Each document must start with its ===FILE:=== delimiter on its own line,
  then the # heading immediately after
- Do NOT write any preamble, summary, or meta-commentary before the first ===FILE:=== delimiter
